تفترضين (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِضِينَ (taftariḍīna) /taf.ta.ri.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# تُفْتَرَضِينَ (tuftaraḍīna) /tuf.ta.ra.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
